top_signals.title: Bond Slide Spreads to Emerging Markets on Fed Rate Hike Bets
top_signals.summary: A global bond selloff spread to emerging markets as investors dumped the riskier debt on expectations that the Federal Reserve will increase US interest rates later this month.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: First Eagle Investments' Appio on Bond Market Selloff
top_signals.summary: First Eagle Investments' Idanna Appio discusses the ongoing rise in bond yields and the broad selloff across global fixed income markets. Appio says the move is not just a US story, but a global one driven by several factors. She speaks with David Ingles and Yvonne Man on August 1, 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: U.S. Crude Inventories Drop amid Continued SPR Draws
top_signals.summary: The American Petroleum Institute (API) estimated that crude oil inventories in the United States fell 2.6 million barrels in the week ending August 28. In the week prior, US crude oil inventories rose by 4.2 million barrels. Commercial crude oil inventories excluding the SPR have lost just over 48 million barrels over the last twenty weeks, with US crude inventories up 3.1 million for the year, according to API data, kept in check by draws from the SPR. For week ending August 28, another 3.1 million barrels left the SPR to aid commercial inventories,…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Five plead guilty in latest federal ATM jackpotting case
top_signals.summary: Federal law enforcement continued to warn about ATM jackpotting gangs as it announced guilty pleas from five Venezuelan nationals.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Dell surges 8% after lifting fiscal 2027 forecast on AI server strength
top_signals.summary: Dell sees AI server revenue tripling in fiscal 2027. Six months ago, it was looking for the number to double.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Over 1 in 3 young Japanese not interested in tying the knot, survey finds
top_signals.summary: The poll by the Children and Families Agency found that 35.1% of those surveyed said they had "no intention" of getting married.
